$description: Type roles: the 23 text styles of Figma's `Unicron Type/` folder, one set for every app and both grounds. Each is a DTCG typography composite. The family is a reference to a tier 1 font; weight, size, line height and letter spacing are Figma's numbers, in Figma's units (px, and em for the percent). The build emits five variables per role: --type-<role>-family, -weight, -size, -leading and -tracking (size and leading in rem, tracking in em). @unicron/ui's stylesheet turns each role into one `type-<role>` utility. A change here is a change in Figma first (scripts/figma-parity.mjs holds the two together).

display.$description: Figma Unicron Type/display: Geist Bold 72/68, -4%. Empty-state hero, big moments. The line box is shorter than the type on purpose (72/68).

display-compact.$description: Figma Unicron Type/display/compact: Geist Bold 48/48, -3%. The compact display size.

title.$description: Figma Unicron Type/title: Geist Bold 32/36, -1.5%. Section and view titles; large screen titles.

lead.$description: Figma Unicron Type/lead: Geist Medium 24/32, -1%. The paragraph that opens a response or a page; sheet and dialog titles.

subtitle.$description: Figma Unicron Type/subtitle: Geist Medium 18/28, -0.5%. Section titles in panels and cards; phone top-bar titles.

body.$description: Figma Unicron Type/body: Geist Regular 16/24. Default reading text.

body-strong.$description: Figma Unicron Type/body/strong: Geist Medium 16/24. Emphasis within body. Differs from body only in weight.

response.$description: Figma Unicron Type/response: Geist Regular 17/28. Model output text.

ui.$description: Figma Unicron Type/ui: Geist Medium 15/20. Controls, buttons, menus.

ui-emphasis.$description: Figma Unicron Type/ui/emphasis: Geist SemiBold 15/20. Emphasized control text. Differs from ui only in weight.

label.$description: Figma Unicron Type/label: Geist Medium 14/20. Form labels, tabs.

caption.$description: Figma Unicron Type/caption: Geist Regular 13/20. Supporting text under media or tables.

overline.$description: Figma Unicron Type/overline: Geist Mono Medium 11/16, +4%. The small label above a title. The only role with a case: upper. Type the text in normal case.

folio.$description: Figma Unicron Type/folio: Geist Mono Medium 12/20. Running headers, page or step markers. Differs from meta only in weight.

meta.$description: Figma Unicron Type/meta: Geist Mono Regular 12/20. Timestamps, model name, counts.

code-inline.$description: Figma Unicron Type/code/inline: Geist Mono Regular 15/20. Inline code. Matches the line height of ui text.

code-display.$description: Figma Unicron Type/code/display: Geist Mono Medium 36/40, +12%. Large codes, for example a one-time code.

number-hero.$description: Figma Unicron Type/number/hero: Geist Bold 168/148, -5%. Hero numbers. The line box is shorter than the type on purpose (168/148).

number-metric.$description: Figma Unicron Type/number/metric: Geist Bold 44/44, -2%. Metric values.

number-index.$description: Figma Unicron Type/number/index: Geist Bold 28/32, -2%. Index numerals (item 03, task 014).

number-count.$description: Figma Unicron Type/number/count: Geist Mono Regular 24/28. Counts.

brand-wordmark.$description: Figma Unicron Type/brand/wordmark: Geist Bold 13/16, +12%. The app wordmark in the App Lockup.

icon-glyph.$description: Figma Unicron Type/icon/glyph: Geist Regular 32/32. The letter in a placeholder mark. No component on the Figma components page uses it.
